text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The public expects Mr. C.B. to become a 
Derby Umamusume. Yet what matters most to 
her isn't the title, but running freely 
from the heart.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Trainer advises her to run freely. Mr. 
C.B. laughs and declares that she'll run 
however she likes, true to herself.
